messages.author: 7aeb022a4635dbce
messages.subject: Stop live reloading
parts: Is there a way to prevent shiny from updating app on browser reload after ui/server file has changed? I want to have one git branch with running app and another for developing and live reloading makes it pointless.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Stop live reloading
parts: No, but that setup seems like a bad idea anyway. If there are images, data files, etc that need to be accessed during the execution of the app you're going to end up in weird states if you switch branches. Much better to have two clones of the repo.
